D1.reason: `disjoint.rs::declared_domains` and `disjoint()` enforce whole-program state, exact `AssetId`, and `Statement::Liability` disjointness, while `merge()` builds a flat sorted union and catches any 0-await scenario duty collision before publication via `Error::AfterInvocation`.

D2.reason: `Pair::start` fixes start order `[0,1]` and `Pair::resume` steps one pending member per event from its isolated `Continuation`. `Pair::report` orders `effects` by invocation then statement order, keeping `left-first` and `right-first` histories/effects distinct despite equal `post`.

D3.reason: `Pair::start` and `Pair::resume` publish only after stage calls, `merge()`, and `sum()` succeed. False guards (`Waiting{advanced:false,segment:None}`) update `latest[member]` while `Pair::history` keeps prior segments, and `Error::Branch`/`AfterInvocation` preserve all work counters.

D4.reason: `Pair::start` passes each member's finite `cap` (`16`, `36`, `cap_total: 52`) into `stage::start` (`continuation.logical.cap`), and `Pair::resume` passes `cli_cap=None`, which `cost::resume_preflight` checks against stored `logical.cap` within `MAX_INVOCATIONS` (256).

D5.reason: `mori-core` and `mori` gate `stage::disjoint` and `disjoint_test` behind non-default `core2-disjoint-draft`. `Pair::report` emits `moriarty-local-disjoint-draft/1`, `unadopted-local-disjoint-product`, and `STAGE_LABELS`, keeping positive `residual` duties without claiming native `Split`.

RV1.reason: `disjoint.rs::Error::public_report()` emits `moriarty-local-disjoint-error-draft/1`, embedding full `stage::outcome_report(Err(rejection))`, earlier-start/prior-pair work, and `Error::AfterInvocation` counters; `disjoint_test.rs::pair_error` routes this `Value` to `core_io::operation`.

RV2.reason: `disjoint_test.rs::run_case` checks each full `Pair::report()` against its golden before `ObservationTables::reference` verifies `starts_with`, moves `history`/`effects` into case `tables`, and writes `prefix_len` references that `disjoint_test_public.rs::expand` losslessly restores.

RV3.reason: `test.rs::aggregate_report` and 1 MiB/64 KiB bounds remain unchanged. Case `tables` remove $O(N^2)$ wire duplication in `disjoint_test.rs` while keeping `Pair::report()` complete and leaving `Pair` unchanged on error with work counters in `Error::public_report()`.

findings: `crates/mori-core/src/stage/disjoint.rs` (`Error::public_report`, `Error::Branch`, `Error::AfterInvocation`) & `crates/mori/src/commands/test/disjoint_test.rs` (`pair_error`): Passing `error.public_report()` (`moriarty-local-disjoint-error-draft/1`) to `core_io::operation` preserves `stage::outcome_report(Err(rejection))` counters, `earlier_start_attempted`/`earlier_start_local_committed`, and `pair_attempted_before`/`pair_committed_before`, while `disjoint_test.rs` halts on `PairError` as a positive manifest runner.

`crates/mori-core/src/stage/disjoint.rs` (`Pair::resume`, `Error::Shape`): Pre-invocation errors in `Pair::resume` (`history.len() >= MAX_INVOCATIONS` or non-pending `member`) return `Error::Shape`, which `Error::public_report()` serializes as `detail.kind = "before-invocation"` with only `message` (omitting `pair_attempted_before` and `pair_committed_before`, unlike `Error::Branch` and `Error::AfterInvocation`). Any future negative diagnostic oracle for resume preflight refusals must account for this distinction.

`crates/mori/src/commands/test/disjoint_test.rs` (`ObservationTables::reference`, `run_case`) & `crates/mori/tests/disjoint_test_public.rs` (`expand`): `run_case` compares the unprojected `Pair::report()` against `expected_start` and each `event.expected` before `ObservationTables::reference` verifies `starts_with` prefix monotonicity and replaces `history`/`effects` with `{"table":...,"prefix_len":N}` under `moriarty-local-disjoint-referenced-draft/1`. `expand()` losslessly restores `expanded_format` and slices `tables[name][..prefix_len]` to match the 10 full stage goldens.

`crates/mori-core/src/stage/disjoint.rs` (`declared_domains`, `merge`, `Pair::start`): `declared_domains` checks static `Statement::Liability` names across whole programs (matching `decode::registry`), whereas 0-await actions skip `decode::canonical_boundary` in `admit::start` and can admit undeclared `Scenario.liabilities` via `runtime::scenario_snapshot`. If an undeclared 0-await scenario duty collides by name, `merge(start_pre(&first)?, start_pre(&second)?)` rejects before `Pair` publication via `Error::AfterInvocation`, preserving both members' `attempted` and `local_committed` counters.
